blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Enzymes) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Enzymes control the chemistry of life. (i) Explain why enzymes are essential for life. (ii) Describe where enzymes are made and where they work in and out of the cell. (4 marks)
(Enzymes zindagi ki chemistry ko control karte hain. (i) Samjhayein ke enzymes zindagi ke liye kyun zaroori hain. (ii) Bayan karein ke enzymes kahan bante hain aur cell ke andar aur bahar kahan kaam karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Metabolism, jaandaron ki tamam chemical sargarmiyon ka majmua, enzymes se control hota hai. Enzymes khaas proteins (biocatalysts) hain jo activation energy kam kar ke khaas reactions tez karte hain aur khud nahi badalte. Enzyme wale reactions baghair enzyme ke reactions se 10³ se 10⁸ guna tez ho sakte hain; enzyme ke saath 30 minute wala reaction baghair enzyme ke aik saal leta. Is liye enzymes ke baghair zindagi na hoti. Mukhtalif cells (jaise red blood cells aur nerve cells) mein enzymes ke mukhtalif set hain, is liye un ke reactions alag hain.

(ii) Tamam enzymes cells ke andar ribosomes banate hain. Phir woh ya to cell ke andar kaam karte hain ya bahar bheje jate hain. Cell ke andar:
1. Bohat se cytoplasm mein hal hote hain, jaise glycolysis ke enzymes.
2. Bohat se kuch organelles ki membranes se mazbooti se jude hote hain.
3. Kuch ribosomes ka lazmi hissa hain, jaise protein synthesis ke enzymes.

book_ref.quote: Enzymes may be defined as specific proteins that speed up specific chemical reactions

blocks.prompt:
2 Enzymes are highly specific and sometimes dangerous to their own cells. (i) Explain why only a certain substrate fits an active site and how the two regions of the active site act. (ii) Explain why pepsin is secreted as pepsinogen. (4 marks)
(Enzymes bohat makhsoos aur kabhi apne cells ke liye khatarnak hote hain. (i) Samjhayein ke active site mein sirf khaas substrate kyun fit hota hai aur active site ke do hisse kaise kaam karte hain. (ii) Samjhayein ke pepsin pepsinogen ki shakal mein kyun kharij hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Enzymes teen jihati globular proteins hain jo lipti hui polypeptide chains se bane hain. Satah par chand amino acids ka chhota gadha active site hai jahan catalysis hoti hai. Is ki shakal bohat makhsoos, teen jihati aur khaas charge wali hai, is liye sirf aik khaas substrate fit hota hai. Is ke do hisse:
1. Binding site: substrate is mein kamzor chemical quwwaton jaise hydrogen bonds se fit hota hai.
2. Catalytic site: reaction karati hai aur substrate products ban jata hai.

(ii) Kuch enzymes ghalat jagah fa'al hon to nuqsan de sakte hain. Pepsin protein hazam karne wala enzyme hai jo apne banane wale cells ke protein structures tabah kar sakta hai. Is liye yeh ghair fa'al shakal pepsinogen mein banta aur cells se bahar bheja jata hai. Apni amal ki jagah pohanch kar pepsin ban kar fa'al hota hai.

book_ref.quote: When it reaches its target site of action, it is activated (pepsin)

blocks.prompt:
3 Many enzymes need non-protein helpers. (i) Define cofactor, apoenzyme and holoenzyme. (ii) Explain how metal ions work as cofactors, with examples. (4 marks)
(Bohat se enzymes ko ghair protein madadgaron ki zaroorat hoti hai. (i) Cofactor, apoenzyme aur holoenzyme ki definition likhein. (ii) Samjhayein ke metal ions cofactors ke taur par kaise kaam karte hain, misaalon ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Cofactors woh izafi ghair protein chemical hisse hain jo bohat se enzymes catalysis mein madad ke liye istemal karte hain; in ki teen qismen hain: metal ions, prosthetic groups aur coenzymes. Enzyme ka protein hissa apoenzyme hai; cofactor samait mukammal enzyme holoenzyme hai (apoenzyme + cofactor = holoenzyme).

(ii) Bohat se enzymes Ca⁺², Mg⁺², Mn⁺², Cu⁺² aur Zn⁺² jaise metal ions ko cofactors banate hain. Yeh metal ions enzymes ki ghair fa'al active sites ko fa'al banate hain. Cofactor ke judne se enzyme ki shakal bhi badalti hai aur woh substrate se mil sakta hai. Molybdenum aur manganese jaise trace elements bhi, jo sehat ke liye zaroori hain, enzymes cofactors ke taur par istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Many enzymes use additional chemical components to aid in catalysis

blocks.prompt:
4 Define coenzyme. Explain how coenzymes such as NAD⁺ carry electrons and energy in the cell, and name vitamins that act as coenzymes. (4 marks)
(Coenzyme ki definition likhein. Samjhayein ke NAD⁺ jaise coenzymes cell mein electrons aur energy kaise le jate hain, aur coenzyme ka kaam karne wale vitamins ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Coenzyme: woh cofactor jo ghair protein organic molecule ho aur enzyme se dheela juda ho.

Kirdar: coenzymes aksar electrons (hydrogen atoms) aik enzyme se doosre tak le ja kar reactions mein hissa lete hain.

NAD⁺: cell ka sab se ahem coenzyme hydrogen acceptor nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD⁺) hai. Hydrogen atom lene par NAD⁺ reduce ho kar NADH banta hai. Hydrogen atom ke electron mein energy hoti hai jo NADH uthata hai. Misaal: cell mein khurak ke oxidation ke waqt enzymes khurak ke molecules se electrons le kar NAD⁺ ko dete hain jo NADH ban jata hai.

Vitamins: bohat se vitamins, jaise niacin aur riboflavin, coenzymes ka kaam karte hain; kuch coenzymes ka hissa hain.

book_ref.quote: The most important coenzyme in cell is the hydrogen acceptor nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the steps by which an enzyme converts its substrate into products, and explain how many enzymes work together in a metabolic pathway. (4 marks)
(Woh qadam bayan karein jin se enzyme substrate ko products mein badalta hai, aur samjhayein ke metabolic pathway mein bohat se enzymes mil kar kaise kaam karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Enzyme ke amal ke qadam:
1. Apni makhsoosiyat ki wajah se enzyme khaas substrate ko pehchanta hai jo active site se judta hai.
2. Enzyme-substrate (ES) complex banta hai aur catalytic site fa'al hoti hai.
3. Catalytic site ke atoms substrate ke khaas bonds par dabao daal kar unhen kamzor karte hain, is liye activation energy kam ho jati hai.
4. Reaction shuru hota hai aur substrate products ban jata hai.
5. Enzyme bina badle products se alag ho jata hai.
Khulasa: E + S → ES → E + P. Enzyme products ki nau'iyat nahi badalta (sucrose hamesha glucose aur fructose deta hai, sucrase ho ya na ho).

Pathway mein enzymes: respiration, photosynthesis aur protein synthesis jaise pechida pathways mein bohat se enzymes silsilewar kaam kar ke qadmon ko control karte hain. Yeh enzymes apne cofactors ke saath ikatthe hote hain. Aik enzyme ka product agle enzyme ka substrate banta hai. Aakhir mein end products bante hain jo feedback se pehle enzyme ko rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: Due to its specificity, an enzyme recognizes a specific substrate

blocks.prompt:
6 What is denaturation of an enzyme? Explain how very high temperature and extreme pH each bring it about. (4 marks)
(Enzyme ka denaturation kya hai? Samjhayein ke bohat zyada temperature aur intehai pH dono ise kaise paida karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Denaturation: enzyme ki globular banawat ka khatam hona, jab bonds polypeptide chains ko sahih jagah par nahi rakh pate. Is se enzyme ke amal ki raftaar tezi se girti hai aur bilkul ruk sakti hai.

Zyada temperature se: enzyme protein ki shakal hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic interactions se qaim hai jo temperature ki tabdeeli se aasani se toot jate hain. Optimum (insani enzymes ke liye 37 °C) se bohat zyada temperature par garmi enzyme ke atoms ki thartharahat barhati hai. Jab thartharahat bohat shadeed ho jaye to bonds polypeptide chains ko jagah par nahi rakh pate aur globular banawat khatam ho jati hai. (Thermophilic bacteria ke proteins mein mazboot bonding hai, is liye woh 70 °C ya zyada par kaam karte hain.)

Intehai pH se: globular banawat mein chains mukhalif charge wale amino acids jaise glutamic acid (–) aur lysine (+) ke bonds se bhi judi hain. Yeh bonds hydrogen ion ki miqdaar se mutasir hote hain. pH ki tabdeeli active site ke amino acids (aur substrate) ki ionization badalti hai; intehai tabdeeli yeh bonds tor kar denaturation kar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: The shape of a protein is determined by the hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain the effect of pH on the rate of enzyme action, with examples of enzymes and their optimum pH. (4 marks)
(Enzyme ke amal ki raftaar par pH ka asar enzymes aur un ke optimum pH ki misaalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Tamam enzymes pH ki tang range mein sab se tez kaam karte hain; thori si kami ya zyadti activity ko dheema ya bilkul band kar deti hai.
2. Har enzyme aik khaas pH, optimum pH, par behtareen kaam karta hai. Pepsin tezabi medium (kam pH) mein fa'al hai; trypsin alkaline medium (zyada pH) mein behtareen. Kachche papite ka papain tezabi aur alkaline dono mein kaam karta hai.
3. Wajah: polypeptide chains mukhalif charge wale amino acids (glutamic acid – aur lysine +) ke bonds se judi hain jo H⁺ ki miqdaar se mutasir hote hain. pH badalne se active site ke amino acids aur substrate ki ionization badal sakti hai. Intehai pH yeh bonds tor kar enzyme ko denature kar deta hai.

Kuch insani enzymes ka optimum pH:

book_ref.quote: All enzymes work at their maximum rate at a narrow range of pH

blocks.prompt:
8 Compare the effect of increasing enzyme concentration with that of increasing substrate concentration on the rate of enzyme action. (4 marks)
(Enzyme ki miqdaar barhane aur substrate ki miqdaar barhane ke enzyme ke amal ki raftaar par asar ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono shuru mein raftaar barhate hain phir raftaar yaksan ho jati hai, magar mukhtalif wajah se:

book_ref.quote: If enzyme concentration is kept constant and the amount of substrate is increased

rows: Raftaar seedha enzyme ki miqdaar par munhasir
Jab tak active sites khaali hon raftaar barhti hai
Zyada enzyme, zyada active sites, zyada substrate jud kar badalta hai
Naya substrate khaali sites se judta hai, waqt mein zyada product
Substrate wohi rahe to izafi enzyme se mazeed substrate nahi judta
Zyada substrate par tamam sites bhari; izafi substrate ko jagah nahi
Aik had ke baad zyada substrate se raftaar nahi barhti

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain reversible and irreversible inhibition of enzymes with examples. (4 marks)
(Enzymes ki reversible aur irreversible inhibition misaalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Inhibitor reversible hoga ya irreversible, yeh inhibitor aur enzyme ke darmiyan banne wale bond ki qisam par munhasir hai.

Irreversible inhibitors: enzyme se covalent bonds banate hain. Dilution, dialysis ya substrate barhane se alag nahi hote. Misalein: penicillin bacteria ki cell wall banane wale enzyme ko mustaqil nakara karti hai; zehar cyanide cytochrome oxidase ke active site mein copper aur iron se jud kar cellular respiration rokta hai.

Reversible inhibitors: enzyme se kamzor bonds (jaise hydrogen bonds) banate hain. Alag ho sakte hain aur substrate barhane se un ka asar khatam ho sakta hai. Misaal: malonate cellular respiration ke enzyme succinate dehydrogenase ko rok kar reaction aarzi dheema karta hai; malonate hatane par asar khatam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Such inhibitors cannot be released by dilution or dialysis or by increasing the concentration of substrate

blocks.prompt:
10 Enzyme inhibitors can heal or kill. (i) Explain how inhibitors are used as drugs, with examples. (ii) Explain how some inhibitors act as poisons, and how competitive antibiotics kill bacteria. (4 marks)
(Enzyme inhibitors shifa bhi dete hain aur maar bhi sakte hain. (i) Samjhayein ke inhibitors dawa ke taur par kaise istemal hote hain, misaalon ke saath. (ii) Samjhayein ke kuch inhibitors zehar kaise bante hain, aur competitive antibiotics bacteria ko kaise maarte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Dawa ke taur par:
1. Aspirin prostaglandin (jo sozish karta hai) banane wale enzymes ko rokti hai, is liye dard aur sozish kam karti hai.
2. Antibiotics bacteria ke enzymes rokti hain; cancer ki dawaiyan cell division ke enzymes rok sakti hain.
3. Khoon jamne ke enzymes ke inhibitors anticoagulants ke taur par istemal hote hain.
4. Inhibitors pharmaceutical tehqeeq mein enzymes ke kaam aur mumkina dawaiyon ke mutaale ke aalaat hain.

(ii) Zehar ke taur par: kuch toxins aur zehar jism ke ahem enzymes rokte hain; jaise cyanide irreversible inhibitor hai jo cytochrome oxidase ke active site mein copper aur iron se jud kar cellular respiration rokta hai. Aisi inhibition ko samajhna poisoning ke ilaj mein madad deta hai.
Competitive antibiotics: in ke molecules bacteria ki zindagi ke liye zaroori enzymes ke substrates se mushabeh hain (book correction: substrates, enzymes nahi). Yeh un enzymes ki active sites se jud kar unhen band karte hain aur bacteria mar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Inhibitors are often used as drugs, but they can also act as poisons

blocks.prompt:
11 The end product of a pathway can regulate its own production. (i) Explain how the final product shuts down a metabolic pathway, with the ATP example. (ii) Explain how succinyl-CoA controls its own formation. (4 marks)
(Pathway ka aakhri product apni paidawar khud control kar sakta hai. (i) Samjhayein ke aakhri product metabolic pathway ko kaise band karta hai, ATP ki misaal ke saath. (ii) Samjhayein ke succinyl-CoA apni banawat kaise control karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Metabolic pathway mein aik reaction ka product agle ka substrate hota hai aur aakhir mein matloob product banta hai. Is ki miqdaar control karne ke liye pathway band karna parta hai. Aakhri product inhibitor ban kar shuru ke enzyme se judta aur us ki shakal badalta hai, woh enzyme substrate se nahi jud pata; pathway band ho jata hai aur mazeed product nahi banta. Misaal: jab cell mein zaroorat se zyada ATP ho to ATP khud non-competitive inhibitor ban kar ATP banane wale enzyme ko rok deta hai.

(ii) Succinic acid aur CoA mil kar succinyl-CoA banate hain, succinyl-CoA synthetase ki madad se. Banne ke baad succinyl-CoA non-competitive inhibitor ban kar enzyme se judta hai; enzyme ruk jata hai aur mazeed succinyl-CoA nahi banta.

book_ref.quote: That enzyme can no longer bind to its substrate

blocks.prompt:
12 Using the classification of enzymes by substrate, describe how proteins, carbohydrates and lipids are broken down by enzymes. (4 marks)
(Substrate ki bunyad par enzymes ki classification istemal karte hue bayan karein ke proteins, carbohydrates aur lipids enzymes se kaise toot'te hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Proteins (proteases):
1. Pepsin aur trypsin bare polypeptides ko chhote polypeptides mein todte hain.
2. Erepsin dipeptides ko amino acids mein todta hai (book correction: kitab mein 'erypsin').

Carbohydrates (carbohydrases): bare carbohydrates ko chhoti units mein todte hain.
1. Amylase starch ya glycogen ko maltose mein; maltase maltose ko glucose mein.
2. Sucrase sucrose ko glucose aur fructose mein; lactase lactose ko glucose aur galactose mein.
3. Cellulase cellulose ko cellobiose (aik disaccharide) ya glucose mein.

Lipids (lipases): pancreatic lipase lipids ko fatty acids aur glycerol mein todta hai.

(Nucleic acids ko nucleases jaise RNAase aur DNAase todte hain.)

book_ref.quote: pepsin and trypsin enzymes catalyse the breakdown of large polypeptides

blocks.prompt:
13 Enzymes are grouped by the type of reaction they catalyse. (i) Differentiate between transferases and lyases. (ii) Differentiate between oxidoreductases and isomerases. (4 marks)
(Enzymes reaction ki qisam se groups mein hain. (i) Transferases aur lyases mein farq bayan karein. (ii) Oxidoreductases aur isomerases mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Transferases: aik khaas functional group (jaise methyl, acyl, amino ya phosphate) aik substrate se doosre ko muntaqil karte hain; jaise hexokinase ATP se glucose ko phosphate group deta hai.
Lyases: baghair paani (non-hydrolytic) ke substrates se groups (jaise CO₂, NH₂) jorte ya nikalte hain; jaise pyruvate decarboxylase pyruvic acid se CO₂ nikalta hai.

(ii) Oxidoreductases: H⁺ ions ya electrons jor kar ya nikal kar substrates ka oxidation/reduction karte hain; jaise cytochrome oxidase cytochrome ka oxidation karta hai.
Isomerases: molecule ke andar tarteeb badal kar aik isomer ko doosre mein badalte hain; jaise hexose isomerase glucose ko fructose banata hai.

book_ref.quote: The enzymes of this class catalyse the transfer of a specific functional group
